title: Emission of a list of trees
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a gate kind $k$, a list of lists of vertex indices, and an existing list of gates, define the result by processing each vertex list in order with the tree-emission procedure. The output is the accumulated gate list and, in the same order, the vertex returned by that procedure for each input list.
